notes: Summary: Fortalice is a mid-stage e-discovery / compliance SaaS that wants to replace a brittle keyword search pipeline with a RAG-backed semantic search and reranking layer. Primary constraints: VPC/private deployment, 7+ year retention and immutable audit logs for chain-of-custody, strict SSO/SAML and KMS for key management. They estimate index scale at 15-30M documents (legal briefs, depositions, contracts). Target UX latency: P50 < 300ms for top-5, P95 < 1s; cost target ~ $0.01-0.03 per query at expected load. Wants embedding + ANN index for recall and a cross-encoder reranker (on shorter candidate sets) for precision. Quoted: "We need provable chain-of-custody and retention — regulators will ask for logs tied to each access. Also, not all models are acceptable; preference for open/verified models and explicit quantization guidance." POC ask: 2-week bench on 500k documents; measure recall, rerank nDCG, and end-to-end latency including network within VPC. Security: they will require sub-processor list, SOC2 evidence, and a contract addendum for data residency. Integrations: SIEM ingestion for audit events, support for KMS-backed key rotation, and long-term cold storage for older documents. Operational: want cost control levers (auto-batching, cache TTLs, quantization profiles) surfaced in console and tied to per-route dashboards. Current sentiment: motivated but risk-averse; procurement timeline depends on legal sign-off and SIEM spec. Quotes from call: "If audit logs can't be immutable and queryable for 7 years we can't go forward"; "We'd like to control the reranker model version independent of the embedding model." Next steps (short): complete security deck, schedule architecture workshop (w/ infra + security), receive sample dataset and run POC, provide a draft MSA + Addendum for data residency and retention.
